 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. **The opportunity** 
 : Project Manager\-GOV\-SaT\-SaT \- TCF \- Infrastructure Advisory \- Ahmedabad
   

  

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

**SaT :**

title: Associate Project Manager - Structural
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Walter P Moore India has an immediate opening for an
 **Associate Project Manager** 
 to join their dynamic Structural Engineering team in the Pune office.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge and experience in the analysis, design, and delivery of structures, utilizing the latest tools and technologies. The sectors served may include Residential and Commercial office buildings, healthcare facilities, airports, and sports venues.
   

  

 An Associate Project Manager will assist the Project Manager / Team Leader’s direction by assisting with technical supervision, staff development, and business development. Here are some key responsibilities for such a position:
   

  

* Project Planning and Management:
* Assist the Project Manager in preparing detailed project plans to meet client/project requirements and deadlines.
* Coordinate with Project Manager to manage the overall project lifecycle from inception through completion, including scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation.
* Ensure compliance with both local and international building codes and regulations.
* Technical Leadership:
* Provide technical guidance to other designers and engineers on the analysis, design, and delivery of structural engineering projects.
* Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineering consultants to develop engineering solutions.
* Utilize advanced engineering tools and techniques to optimize project outcomes.
* Develop/implement/follow a robust QA/QC process to review engineering deliverables and initiate appropriate corrective actions when necessary.
* As and when required as per client requirements conduct regular site visits in India during the construction phase of the project. Prepare site observation reports and share with client and contractor
* Client Interaction and Communication:
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, architects, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication.
* Understand and address client needs and expectations and provide regular updates on project progress.
* Negotiate with clients and contractors to resolve issues and ensure project delivery within agreed parameters.
* Whenever required participate in business development and client presentations.
* Professional Development and Innovation:
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in structural engineering and project management methodologies.
* Encourage continuous learning and development within the team through workshops, courses, and professional certifications.
* Explore innovative solutions and technologies that can improve efficiency and outcomes of structural engineering projects.


 Our clients include architects, developers, institutional entities, and contractors. The successful candidate must also demonstrate a strong customer service orientation, underpinned by a proactive “can\-do” attitude.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* A minimum of eight years of core experience in structural engineering.
* A Master's degree in Structural Engineering is required.
* Candidates with a PhD in Structural Engineering with the required experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with experience in Structural steel, RCC and PT design shall be given preference.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience leading teams of engineers and modelers.
* Proactive and well\-organized, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* A strong orientation towards client service.


 Walter P Moore is an equal employment opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (including offering competitive compensation and benefits packages) to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Overview**
 Walter P Moore is an international company of engineers, architects, innovators, and creative people who solve some of the world’s most complex structural and infrastructure challenges. Providing structural, diagnostics, civil, traffic, parking, transportation, enclosure, WPM technology and construction engineering services, we design solutions that are cost\- and resource\-efficient, forward\-thinking, and help support and shape communities worldwide. Founded in 1931 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, our 1000\+ professionals work across 26 U.S. offices and 8 international locations.

description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

 Website
 **Trading Technologies**
 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. title: Lead Mechanical Engineer - Product Development
description:
Immediate Hiring \| Joining Date: 1st October 2026 (or Earlier Preferred)
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Company: iNSPIRE Design
 



  





  





 Please Read Before Applying
 



 We are looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer who can join on or before 1st September 2026\.
 



 If you are serving a notice period that extends beyond this date, please apply only if your current employer is willing to provide an early release.
 



 This is an immediate requirement, and applications from candidates who can join within the required timeline will be given preference.
 



  





  





 About iNSPIRE Design
 



 iNSPIRE Design is a product development and engineering company based in Ahmedabad. We work with startups, established companies, research institutions, and healthcare professionals to develop new products from early\-stage concepts through functional prototypes and manufacturing readiness.
 



 Our projects primarily involve medical devices, electromechanical products, test fixtures, consumer products, automation systems, and custom engineering solutions. The work is highly varied and requires strong first\-principles engineering, practical problem\-solving, rapid prototyping, and close coordination with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are looking for a senior, hands\-on mechanical engineer who can take technical ownership of complex product development projects.
 



 This is not a role limited to CAD modelling or preparing drawings. The selected candidate will be expected to understand client requirements, develop product architectures, make engineering decisions, guide junior engineers and designers, resolve prototype failures, and lead projects through design, testing, iteration, and manufacturing handover.
 



 The person should be capable of operating independently and gradually taking ownership of the day\-to\-
 



 day engineering function within the company.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





  





 Product Development and Engineering
 


* Lead mechanical product development projects from initial requirements through functional prototype and manufacturing readiness.
* Convert incomplete or evolving client requirements into clear engineering specifications and development plans.
* Develop product architecture, mechanisms, assemblies, enclosures, structural components, and electromechanical integration concepts.
* Perform engineering calculations related to loads, stresses, fits, tolerances, motion, thermal behaviour, material selection, and manufacturing feasibility.
* Identify technical risks early and develop practical methods to test and reduce those risks.
* Review existing designs critically and recommend improvements based on performance, reliability, cost, usability, and manufacturability.
* Troubleshoot prototype failures and lead structured root\-cause analysis and corrective action.



  





  





 Design and Documentation
 


* Create and review detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Apply appropriate GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, fits, clearances, fastener selection, and assembly considerations.
* Maintain proper revision control, design records, BOMs, technical specifications, and project documentation.
* Ensure designs are suitable for prototyping as well as eventual production.
* Conduct design reviews and approve engineering outputs before release.



  





  





 Prototyping and Testing
 


* Plan and supervise the fabrication and assembly of proof\-of\-concept and functional prototypes.
* Select suitable prototyping methods, including 3D printing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, casting, and off\-the\-shelf component integration.
* Develop test plans, fixtures, acceptance criteria, and validation methods.
* Personally participate in prototype assembly, testing, debugging, and design iteration where required.
* Make sound engineering decisions even when complete data or ideal resources are unavailable.



  





  





 Manufacturing and Vendor Coordination
 


* Work directly with machine shops, fabricators, moulders, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Review vendor quotations, manufacturing processes, tolerances, material specifications, and technical capabilities.
* Resolve manufacturing and assembly issues without compromising critical product requirements.
* Support design for manufacturing, design for assembly, cost reduction, and production handover activities.
* Evaluate whether components should be custom\-developed, modified, or sourced as standard parts.



  





  





 Technical Leadership
 


* Guide and review the work of mechanical engineers, industrial designers, interns, and prototyping staff.
* Break larger projects into clearly defined engineering tasks and assign them effectively.
* Establish practical design standards, review processes, calculation practices, and documentation systems.
* Coach junior team members while maintaining accountability for timelines and quality.
* Raise the overall technical capability and engineering discipline of the organisation.
* Take responsibility for technical decisions rather than depending on constant direction from the founder.



  





  





 Project and Client Ownership
 


* Participate in client discussions to understand technical requirements, constraints, and priorities.
* Explain engineering decisions, risks, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Prepare realistic project plans, resource estimates, development timelines, and technical deliverables.
* Track engineering progress and proactively address delays, dependencies, and technical blockers.
* Represent the company confidently during technical reviews, vendor discussions, and client meetings.
* Balance engineering quality with commercial realities, project budgets, and delivery commitments.



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline.
* Approximately 7–12 years of relevant experience in mechanical product development, machine design, medical devices, electromechanical products, automation, or a similar field.
* Strong hands\-on experience taking physical products from concept through prototyping and manufacturing.
* Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or a comparable parametric CAD platform.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, tolerances, GD\&T, and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated ability to perform engineering calculations and validate designs through testing.
* Experience working directly with vendors and resolving real\-world manufacturing problems.
* Experience leading projects or mentoring junior engineers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-moving, project\-driven environment.



  





  





 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience developing medical devices or healthcare\-related products.
* Experience with electromechanical systems involving motors, sensors, actuators, PCBs, wiring, batteries, heating systems, fluid systems, or embedded electronics.
* Familiarity with risk management, verification, validation, and regulated product development.
* Working knowledge of FEA, thermal analysis, tolerance analysis, and design optimisation.
* Experience with injection moulding, silicone moulding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, project plans, cost estimates, and client presentations.
* Exposure to quality systems, ISO 13485, design controls, or medical device documentation would be an advantage.



  





  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 The right candidate will be:
 


* A strong engineer first and a manager second.
* Comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility for the outcome.
* Highly practical and capable of turning concepts into working physical products.
* Willing to question assumptions and challenge technically weak approaches.
* Systematic when investigating failures and resolving engineering problems.
* Capable of balancing ideal engineering solutions with cost, timelines, available resources, and manufacturability.
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and industries.
* Able to communicate directly with clients and defend engineering decisions.
* Interested in building an engineering team and improving how product development is executed across the company.



  





  





 What This Role Is Not
 



 This is not a role for someone whose experience is limited to:
 


* Creating CAD models based on instructions provided by others.
* Managing teams without remaining technically hands\-on.
* Working only on one narrow component or process within a large organisation.
* Preparing presentations and reports without building and testing physical products.
* Waiting for complete requirements before beginning engineering work.



  





  





 Why Join iNSPIRE Design
 


* Work on diverse and technically challenging product development projects.
* Take meaningful ownership of products rather than working on isolated components.
* Work directly with founders, clients, researchers, doctors, startups, and manufacturing partners.
* Build prototypes and see designs progress from initial concepts to real physical products.
* Play a central role in developing the company’s engineering function.
* Opportunity to grow into broader engineering and technical leadership responsibilities as the organisation expands.



  





  





 Application Requirements
 



 Candidates should submit:
 


* An updated resume.
* A brief portfolio or examples of products, mechanisms, machines, or assemblies they have personally developed.
* A clear description of their individual contribution to each project.
* Details of one significant prototype or product failure they diagnosed and resolved.
* Current location, notice period, and availability for an on\-site role in Ahmedabad.

 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.

 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount

* Map how work currently moves through the agency: brief → proposal → kickoff → delivery → review → renewal. Find where it breaks.

* Track project timelines and deliverables across accounts, flag slippage before clients do

* Own internal reporting: what's on time, what's at risk, what's profitable

**6 months onward \- client\-facing** 



* Take direct ownership of select client relationships (starting smaller/lower\-risk accounts, scaling up)

* Be the point of escalation before it needs to reach a founder



**2–3 years \- ops leadership** 



* Own agency operations end to end: resourcing, delivery quality, tooling, process

* Be a founder\-level thinking partner on how the business is structured and run

* 1–2 years of experience in agency operations, client servicing, or project management \- ideally at a marketing, design, or digital agency

 Most ops or associate roles at agencies keep you in a lane.
